notes.notes:
[h1]ADDED[/h1][p]- more weather presets[/p][p]- new items:[/p][p]  - added light sticks[/p][p]  - hand grenade[/p][p]  - throwing a mine or canister into a campfire will cause an explosion that kills now via Steam[/p][p]- more quests[/p][p]- notification system that warns about low fuel, nuclear strike, etc.[/p][p]- leaderboard: top 4 survivors now displayed in the main menu[/p][p]- two new snowy forest levels[/p][p]- forester’s house on one of the locations[/p][p]- radio voice hints with localized subtitles[/p][p]- creepy monster models in the forest for atmosphere[/p][p]- more crafting recipes[/p][p]- rebind button for voice chat[/p][h1]CHANGED[/h1][p]- reworked quest system: 1 quest per level, quests unlock crafting recipes[/p][p]- campfires must now be lit by interaction[/p][p]- campfires now heal up to 75% health if you stand near them[/p][p]- reduced max players per session from 10 to 4 (intended design + host couldn’t handle >4 players properly)[/p][p]- screen shake now depends on distance to big monsters[/p][p]- campfires now deal damage if standing too close[/p][p]- big refactor & optimization of network synchronization[/p][p]- more detailed text tutorial on the train board[/p][p]- levels now load randomly from 5[/p][p]- balanced crafting recipe ingredients[/p][p]- reduced broken glass effect[/p][p]- rebalanced item spawn in bunker[/p][h1]FIXED[/h1][p]- bug where a player leaving game broke the workbench[/p][p]- bug where items selected for extraction differed between client and server[/p][p]- bug where quests didn’t complete on clients[/p][p]- session search by name in session menu[/p][p]- bug where items stayed in chests after reload[/p][p]- bug where players froze and lost input after opening settings menu and leaving location[/p][p]- bug where broken screen effect didn’t reset after respawn[/p][p]- bug where different players saw different items in the red puzzle room[/p][p]- bug where crowbar broke inventory, blocking item switching[/p][p]- bug where players fell through bunker floor on level 2[/p][p]- duplicate animation playback[/p][p]- bugs with visual hints highlighting items in bunker[/p][p]- bug where players had different stats shown[/p][p]- bug where host couldn’t hear clients in dead chat[/p][p]- bug where players froze between extractions inside train safe zone[/p][p]- many compilation errors causing game crashes[/p][p]- some localization issues[/p][p]KNOWN BUGS[/p][p]- sometimes 1st-person camera shifts, interaction center misaligned[/p][p]- full freeze once every 1–2 hours (10–20% chance)[/p][p]- can’t interact with items at low FPS[/p][p]- leaving bunker with 2 players at once sometimes fails to teleport one[/p][p]- player sounds missing on some levels

[/p][h3][b][u]Reminder: many bugs appear due to weak host hardware or bad connections, where clients lose packets or wait 3–4s for updates, missing game state changes.[/u][/b][/h3][p]We’ll keep optimizing the game & netcode so it can be played on weaker devices and slower internet.[/p][p]Thank you all for your support, we are moving steadily towards release.  [/p][p]We remind you that we are just three enthusiasts developing the game in our free time, aiming to make gamedev our profession and become independent.  [/p][p]So please wishlist the game, share it with friends and streamers.  [/p][h2]Have a great game!!![/h2][p][/p]

notes.title: Forgive us!
notes.notes:
[h1]Unfortunately,[/h1] [h2]we received a lot of feedback regarding the visual presentation of our Steam page, so we decided to bring back my rough in-game renderer. In the future, I’ll try to find an artist and ask them to create a proper one for us.[/h2]

[h1]Many [/h1] [h2]players also complained that stamina runs out too quickly, so we’ve increased its regeneration rate. Additionally, a lot of players mentioned that our UI looks too similar to Lethal Company, so we’ve started creating our own retro-style version (for now, we've only changed the HP bar, but we’ll redesign the entire in-game HUD later).[/h2]

[h1]We [/h1][h2]also want to apologize for the appearance of the Google Form survey. It was originally intended for a closed group of beta testers who were playing before the game became popular. I have no idea how it ended up in the demo version. I'm sorry we didn't manage to disable it in time when a large number of players started joining. But it's disabled now![/h2]

[h1]At the same time,[/h1] [h2]we received a lot of positive feedback and many great ideas from you, which we’ve taken into account and will implement in future development.[/h2]

[h1]And just a reminder[/h1] [h2]— you can influence the game's development by sending us your feedback and ideas through the Discord form.[/h2]

[h2]Thank you all for sharing the game with your friends. We’ll make it even better thanks to you![/h2]

notes.title: Patch Notes - 04/04/2025 (Added Hong Kong Region)
notes.notes:
🛠️ Patch Notes
✨ Added
• Hong Kong Region
• A chemistry bottle that weakens players inside bunkers.
• Player eye movement, head turning, and gaze tracking toward nearby players — just because it looks cool.
• An analytics data collection agreement prompt.
• New crafting materials: chip, rag, pills, microchips, and batteries. Crafting recipes now require more appropriate items:

 • Speed upgrades require specific colored pills 💊
 • Inventory slot upgrades now require rags 🧻

• Voice pitch changes when shrinking are now less extreme.
• The hamster 🐹 now dies in two hits instead of three.

🐞 Fixed
• Fixed player stat bars scaling incorrectly after a raid.
• Fixed items getting stuck in the host's hands when dropped.
• Improved overall game balance.
• Reworked enemy behavior:
 • Fixed several AI bugs
 • Added more sound effects
 • Improved enemy animations

⚠️ Known Issues
• Bunker exit door sometimes doesn’t spawn for clients.
• If the last surviving player leaves, it breaks the session.
• Enlarged players can get stuck in unexpected places.

• Some items may become unlootable after a player's death.

🙏 Thanks for playing, and keep the feedback coming!

notes.title: Update based on community feedback

[b]We've listened to your feedback and made some exciting improvements in the current demo version to make your gameplay more comfortable![/b] 😊

[*] [b]Session Visibility:[/b] Try to resolved the issue where players couldn’t see their friends’ sessions. 👀🤝
[*] [b]Strike Radius Adjustment:[/b] Reduced the strike radius of the Crowbar for better attack aiming. 🎯✂️
[*] [b]New Trailer & Stream:[/b] Dropped a brand new trailer and kicked off a live stream—check it out now! 🎬📺
[/list]

[h2]Known Bugs 🐛🔍[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Enemy Freeze:[/b] The hamster can still sometimes freeze in place after killing a player. 🐹❄️
[*] [b]Collider Glitch:[/b] Dropping two-handed heavy items at your feet in the bunker might push you through wall colliders, causing you to fall into the train area. 🚧🚂
[*] [b]Password Issue:[/b] Text-based session passwords don’t work currently—only numeric passwords are supported. 🔠❌
[*] [b]Exit Door Spawn:[/b] Rare instances of exit doors not spawning correctly in the dungeon for clients. 🚪🔄
[*] [b]Spectator Audio:[/b] Players in spectator mode are difficult to hear. 👥🔇
[*]  [b]Ghost Voices:[/b] Dead players can still speak from their death location. 👻🗣️
[*] [b]Key Responsiveness:[/b] The 1-2-3-4 keys may respond poorly during gameplay. ⌨️🐢
[/list]

[b]Please add the game to your wishlist, leave your reviews on Steam, and share your ideas for improvements – because we're building this game just for YOU!!![/b] 💖🙏

[i]Thank you all for your incredible support, positive feedback, and active bug hunting. We hope to create a unique and, most importantly, fun gaming experience for you and your friends![/i] 🌟🎉
